vulnerabilities.description:
Ferret Scan detected cloud resource identifier in this file.

**Location:** <golden:cloud_resources_test_context> (line 1)
**Confidence:** HIGH (95.0%)
**Detected by:** cloud_resources validator

**Context:**
```
prod arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/PaymentsAdmin
```

**Remediation:**
Replace the identifier with a variable, a parameter or a service-discovery lookup. These identifiers embed account, subscription, project or tenant anchors that reveal ownership and infrastructure layout, so scrub them from anything shared outside your organization.
vulnerabilities.name: Cloud Resource Identifier Detected
